description: Emit several custom events for one subscriber in order. Events are processed independently and sequentially, so a partial failure can still leave earlier events recorded. Without automations:trigger the call succeeds but starts no sequence (sequenceTriggersRan false, reason missing_scope).

attributes.description: Custom attributes to set on the subscriber.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

events.description: Events to trigger, in order, for this subscriber.

eventId.description: Your own id for this event, making a re-run idempotent on both the live and historical paths.

occurredAt.description: When the event actually happened (ISO 8601). When every event in the batch is more than an hour old the batch is imported as history in one idempotent write, with no sequences, sync rules, waiting steps or webhooks; the contact's signup date also moves back to the earliest event in the batch (never later).

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

name: trigger_subscriber_events

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `trigger_subscriber_events` MCP tool.

events.description: List of recorded event records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceTriggersRan.description: False when no sequence could start from this call (see sequenceTriggersSkippedReason).

sequenceTriggersSkippedReason.description: missing_scope: key lacks automations:trigger (write still applied). not_requested: enrollInSequences false. historical: recorded as history.

subscriber.description: The subscriber record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
